method: TikHub v1 (fetch_user_info_by_username_v2 -> fetch_user_reels) latest page per account; every reel with play_count >= 50000 downloaded at full video_versions resolution and coded from the actual video (ffmpeg frame sampling at 0/3/10/25s + 50%/90%, a 0.0-1.0s hook strip at 0.2s steps, a full 1-frame-per-1.5s contact sheet watch, plus PCM envelope / band-energy / cross-correlation audio analysis).
coder_note: Single-rater coding, but derived from the full video rather than thumbnails. Structural timings (question cadence, silence gaps, answer-reveal times) are measured programmatically, not eyeballed. VO word readings come from the on-screen subtitle band; no speech-to-text was available locally, so the literal VO wording is partial.

structure.per_question_beats: ~4.0s question card (club badges + draining timer) -> ~1.0s blank wipe -> ~2.0s answer card (player cutout + name pill)

A1 reveal: Kylian Mbappe cutout + white pill 'KYLIAN MBAPPE'; timer bar empty
Q3: AC Milan 2015 >> PSG 2021 / Man City 2025 (scene cut detected at 14.0)
Q4 (4-club path): Real Madrid 2016 >> BVB 2018 / Inter 2020 >> PSG 2021

structure.escalation_labelling: no numeric counter. Escalates two ways: (a) transfer-path length 3 clubs for Q1-Q3 -> 4 clubs for Q4-Q6; (b) colour state change - Q1-Q5 cyan-to-purple gradient, Q6 yellow-to-orange with the logo recoloured to match

voice.pacing_role: none - the clock does the pacing, not a narrator
voice.evidence: no caption/subtitle pixels anywhere across a 1-frame-per-1.5s full-length sheet; median PCM level -62.3 dB (audio is silent most of the time); onsets are metronomic at ~0.20/0.40s intervals, not speech-rate; bass band (<200 Hz) at -65.9 dB rules out both a music bed and a male voice fundamental

text.question_render: club crests in a 2x2 grid joined by chevron arrows, year in large white numerals under each crest

withholding.which_withheld: Q6 only - the final and hardest (4-club path ending at Real Madrid 2026)
withholding.cta_mechanic: the withheld question IS the CTA. When Q6's timer empties, the video cuts to a full-screen card reading 'LEAVE YOUR ANSWER IN THE COMMENTS' and holds it for the last ~1.3s over silence. One specific unanswered thing to type, arriving at the exact moment the clock runs out.

voice.subtitle_style: word-by-word 'karaoke' auto-captions - one word at a time, centred, white bold with a dark outline, with a scale-pop on emphasised words (the word 'forget' renders small then large across two consecutive states)
voice.read_style: TTS-sounding / machine-assembled, not a fresh human read
voice.read_style_evidence: the first 11.75s of PCM is BIT-IDENTICAL to sibling episode DbYCstGqZf9, and a second block 13.4-17.2s is identical too - 22% of the track is shared verbatim between episodes. A human re-reading a script cannot produce bit-identical audio. The pattern is a fixed carrier VO with only the answer-name inserts swapped.
voice.pacing_role: reads the setup, counts the questions in ('First...', 'Second...', 'the last one'), names each answer at the reveal, and delivers the spoken comment CTA

withholding.which_withheld: none - every answer resolves on screen and persists in the answer sheet

The VO delivers a spoken comment ask at ~63-65s ('...don't forget to tell... comment...') just before the final question, and the caption sets the bar ('If you get 10/10 you're true Map Master'). The viewer is asked to type their SCORE, not a withheld answer.

audio_bed.description: voice-dominant. No continuous music bed - the speech band (300-3400 Hz, -21.6 dB) leads the low band (-24.5 dB) and the high band (-30.7 dB), and the envelope shows ~33 sub -35 dB gaps consistent with phrase pauses

loop.evidence: ends on the completed board (all 10 chips filled, counter '10', Turkey revealed); frame 0 is the empty board with counter '00'. The template chrome is identical across the cut, so a replay is continuous in LAYOUT, but the game state snaps from full to empty. Not a designed seamless loop.
